name: socis-agent
title_zh: SOCIS Agent 的遥控器：配置、换肤、扩展
tagline_zh: 别在 YAML 里迷路，也别为改个提示词重写整个 Agent。这套 Skill 把 SOCIS 的调校拆成四块。
tagline_en: Stop wandering in YAML or rewriting agents for a prompt tweak. This Skill splits SOCIS tuning into four.
desc_en: Use, configure, theme, extend, and orchestrate SOCIS Agent.
why_zh: 不是文档搬运工，而是把『配置、主题、扩展、编排』四个动作固化成可调用的操作原语。
why_en: Not a doc scraper—it turns configure, theme, extend, and orchestrate into callable primitives, so the agent can tweak itself.
limit_zh: 只认 SOCIS Agent 仓库结构，换别的 Agent 框架直接失效。改的是本地文件，不负责推送、CI 或部署。
limit_en: Only works with SOCIS Agent's repo layout; other frameworks no-op. Edits local files only—no push, CI, or deploy. Orchestration covers declared.
title_en: Remote for SOCIS Agent: configure, theme, extend.
